description: This file defines the FileSystemStore class implementing IFileStore, providing file and directory operations on a physical file system, including get, create, delete, move, copy, and stream access methods.

classes.name: FileSystemStore
classes.description: Implements IFileStore to manage files and directories on a physical file system, with methods for retrieving info, creating, deleting, moving, copying, and streaming files.

methods.name: GetFileInfoAsync
methods.description: Retrieves file info asynchronously for a given path.

methods.name: GetDirectoryInfoAsync
methods.description: Retrieves directory info asynchronously for a given path.

methods.name: GetDirectoryContentAsync
methods.description: Gets contents of a directory, optionally including subdirectories.

methods.name: TryCreateDirectoryAsync
methods.description: Attempts to create a directory at the specified path.

methods.name: TryDeleteFileAsync
methods.description: Attempts to delete a file at the specified path.

methods.name: TryDeleteDirectoryAsync
methods.description: Attempts to delete a directory at the specified path.

methods.name: MoveFileAsync
methods.description: Moves a file from oldPath to newPath.

methods.name: CopyFileAsync
methods.description: Copies a file from srcPath to dstPath.

methods.name: GetFileStreamAsync
methods.description: Gets a read stream for a file by path or file store entry.

methods.name: CreateFileFromStreamAsync
methods.description: Creates a file from a stream, with optional overwrite.

methods.name: GetPhysicalPath
methods.description: Resolves a relative path to an absolute physical path, ensuring it stays within the root file system path.
